title: 30A Serenity Sands
meta_description: Welcome to 30A Serenity Sands! 7BR new luxury home with heated pool, spa, golf cart \& Gulf views, just 3 blocks from Gulf Place beach!
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to the exquisite 30a Serenity Sands, an awe-inspiring newly constructed luxury home situated in the vibrant heart of Gulf Place. Whether you're seeking a haven for family reunions or a haven for corporate retreats, this remarkable residence promises an unparalleled fusion of opulence and comfort. Nestled just a stone's throw away from Gulf Place/Dune Allen, renowned as one of 30a's destinations, you'll find yourself immersed in a world of convenience, with shopping, dining, nightly entertainment, and an array of activities at your fingertips. The home has an abundance of spaces designed for both entertaining and relaxation within 30a Serenity Sands. From the expansive kitchen island that graciously accommodates up to 14 guests to the irresistible allure of the heated pool and spa, every facet of this home is meticulously crafted to elevate your beach getaway experience. Step outside onto the multiple levels, balconies, and outdoor patio spaces, where the gentle sea breeze invites you to unwind amidst the serene surroundings. Whether you're basking in the camaraderie of group gatherings or seeking moments of solitude, 30a Serenity Sands offers a plethora of options to suit your every mood. For those with larger groups yearning for double the fun, consider booking the adjacent property and elevate your stay to new heights of enjoyment and camaraderie!

\*\*\* NEW CONSTRUCTION \*\*\*
\*\*\* PRIVATE HEATED POOL \& SPA \*\*\*
\*\*\*GOLF CART INCLUDED\*\*\*
\*\*\* PEAK-A-BOO VIEWS OF THE GULF \*\*\*

ABOUT THE AREA: Gulf Place was specifically designed to slow folks down with beautiful palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, outdoor patios with large umbrellas, nature walking trails, plentiful green spaces, and park benches to sit and enjoy the views. This community features some of 30A's most popular restaurants, like Shunk Gulley and The Perfect Pig. Whether you are looking for an epic culinary experience, a fun feast for the whole family or just grab a quick bite to take to the beach, Gulf Place has it all.

BEACH ACCESS: This lovely home is 3 blocks from Ed Walline Public Beach Access. Hop on your bikes and take a stroll down to the beach!

ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 20
• Bedroom 1 -- King Bed (1), ensuite bath -- 1st Floor
• Bedroom 2 -- 2 Sets of Triple XL Twin Bunk, shared Bath -- 1st Floor
• Bedroom 3 -- King Bed, ensuite bath -- 2nd Floor
• Bedroom 4 -- King Bed, ensuite bath -- 2nd Floor
• Bedroom 5 -- King Bed, ensuite bath -- 3rd Floor
• Bedroom 6 -- King Bed, ensuite bath -- 3rd Floor
• Bedroom 7 -- 1 Set of Triple XL Twin Bunk -- 3rd Floor
Queen sleeper sofa---3rd Floor

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Heated Pool \& Spa
• Private Back Yard
• 3 Blocks to the Beach
• 2 Adult Bikes
• Outdoor Entertainment Area
• Grill
• Smart TV's throughout the house
• Full Size Washer \& Dryers on each floor
• Chef's Kitchen with enormous island, 2 dishwashers
• Coffee Maker - Drip \& Pod
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Please note: A queen sleeper sofa is located on the third floor but is not pictured in the current photos.
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Pool heat is $150 per day and must be added for the entire length of stay. No exceptions. Tampering with pool equipment will result in a $200 charge.

Parking Details:
- There is room to park 4 vehicles.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
